name: Gaussian Graph Network
definition: A feed-forward network that generates efficient and generalizable 3D Gaussian representations from multi-view images by modeling relations between Gaussian groups from different views using a Gaussian Graph structure, enabling message passing and aggregation at the Gaussian level.
summary: Gaussian Graph Network generates 3D Gaussian representations from multi-view images by explicitly modeling relations between Gaussian groups via a graph structure, enabling message passing to mitigate artifacts and reduce memory costs.
